reading_note: The teaching describes the spiritual process by which the interior eye is opened: the natural body's outer functioning is temporarily suspended (signified by brief sickness), the spirit is withdrawn from sensory bondage, and influx descends so that interior realities — names, the Deep, the light — are perceived. Different classes of recipients are distinguished by how readily their interior is loosed. The arc moves from withdrawal of natural consciousness, through reception of influx into the inner faculties, into the unveiling of interior names and the descent into the Deep, culminating in the seven (a complete state of regenerate seeing) being taken into the light of the cosmos as it truly exists.
